topic: Write Flood Safety Guidelines(写一份洪水安全指南)
genre: 应用文 / 安全指南(safety guidelines:before / during / after a flood)
source: 外研社版必修第三册 Unit 6 Developing ideas:根据飓风安全指南,写一份洪水安全指南(灾前/灾中/灾后该做与不该做的事)。
prompt_cn: 假设你是学校广播站成员,最近你们地区进入雨季,常有洪水威胁。请用英语写一份约80词的「洪水安全指南」,内容包括:① 洪水来临前要做的1-2件事(如备足食物饮水、把贵重物品搬到高处);② 洪水期间要做和不要做的事(如立刻转移到高处、不要涉水);③ 一句鼓励大家做好准备的话。要求条理清晰、用上 Remember to… / Never… / It's important to… 等安全指南常用句式。
prompt_en: Suppose you are a member of your school radio station. The rainy season has begun and floods are a common threat in your area. Write flood safety guidelines (about 80 words) including: 1) one or two things to do before a flood (e.g. store food and water, move valuables higher up); 2) what to do and what NOT to do during a flood (e.g. move to high ground at once, never walk through fast-moving water); 3) one sentence to encourage everyone to be prepared. Use expressions such as 'Remember to…', 'Never…', 'It's important to…'.
points: 灾前准备(Before a flood: store sufficient food and water; move valuables to a higher floor)
灾中行动(During a flood: move to high ground immediately; listen to warnings)
禁止事项(Never walk or drive through fast-moving water; do not drink flood water)
鼓励做好准备(Being prepared is the best way to stay safe.)
model_essay:
Flood Safety Guidelines

The rainy season has arrived, and floods are a real threat. Here is how to stay safe.

Before a flood: Remember to store sufficient food, clean water and batteries. It's important to move valuable things to a higher floor.

During a flood: Move to high ground immediately and listen to the latest warnings. Never walk or drive through fast-moving water, and do not drink the flood water; otherwise you may get sick.

Being well prepared is the best way to keep your family safe. Stay calm, stay safe!
model_translation:
洪水安全指南

雨季已到,洪水是实实在在的威胁。下面教你如何保持安全。

洪水来临前:记得备足食物、洁净饮用水和电池。把贵重物品搬到更高的楼层很重要。

洪水期间:立刻转移到高处,收听最新警报。绝不要涉水或驾车穿过湍急的水流,也不要喝洪水,否则可能生病。

做好充分准备是保护家人安全的最好办法。保持冷静,保持安全!

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:灾前准备 / 灾中该做与不该做 / 鼓励做好准备
分 before / during 等清晰分点、条目并列、行文连贯,符合安全指南文体
祈使句与 Remember to / Never / It's important to 等句式运用得当,语法基本无误

required_structure: 灾前 Before a flood: Remember to … / It's important to …
灾中 During a flood: Move to high ground immediately …
禁止 Never walk or drive through fast-moving water …
鼓励 Being well prepared is the best way to stay safe.
key_expressions: Remember to store sufficient food and clean water.
Never walk or drive through fast-moving water.
Being well prepared is the best way to stay safe.

high_sentences: Remember to store sufficient food, clean water and batteries.
Move to high ground immediately and listen to the latest warnings.
Never walk or drive through fast-moving water.
Being well prepared is the best way to keep your family safe.

error_pairs.correct: It's important to move valuables higher.
error_pairs.note: It's important to do sth,后接不定式。

error_pairs.wrong: Don't drink the flood water, otherwise you will sick.
error_pairs.correct: Don't drink the flood water; otherwise you will get sick.
error_pairs.note: sick 是形容词,要用 get/be sick;otherwise 前用分号或句号。

error_pairs.wrong: When flooded, move to high ground are important.
error_pairs.correct: When flooded, moving to high ground is important.
error_pairs.note: 动名词短语作主语视为单数,谓语用 is。
